summary.en: Rewrite the system prompt of every request behind Magpie with your agent-purge persona: four agent APIs, four modes, per-agent scoping and a visual persona page. Built-in personas or .md imports work without the CLI.
summary.zh: 把 agent-purge 当前的人设与模式写进每次经过 magpie 网关的请求：四种 agent API、四种模式、按 Agent 限定范围，带可视化人设页；不装 CLI 也能用内置人设或导入 .md。
